🚀 Jaden Industries is AVAILABLE NOW on Microsoft Store, XBOX One and XBOX Series X|S!

🎮 Get it today on the Microsoft or XBOX Store and start building your cozy sky factory!

The Spotter: Dig or Die - Official Launch Trailer | XBOX Series X|S
Dig by day. Defend by night. Survive at all costs! 

The Spotter: Dig or Die is OUT NOW on XBOX Series X|S! Welcome to the worst gas station in Nevada, where mutant hordes are knocking at your door and the fate of the world might just depend on you. Dig deep underground to uncover valuable resources, upgrade your equipment, and transform your rusty outpost into an unstoppable fortress. When night falls, hordes of mutants come crawling out of the wasteland, and it's up to you to hold the line. Build deadly defenses, unlock powerful weapons, discover game-changing roguelike artifacts, and take control of your turrets to fight back against the chaos. And remember: you've got a broken receiver to repair and a very important message from the President to catch! 

Play The Spotter: Dig or Die on XBOX Series X|S today.
